note: manual curated naming for high-value remaining functions (intrusive list family + ARM exception ctx + unaligned memcpy + wrappers), verified via full-body disasm dump

names.name: intrusive_list_push_front
names.comment: intrusive singly-linked list: push node r1 to head; head@[r0], tail@[r0,#4], count@[r0,#8], link offset@[r0,#0xa] (halfword); empty -> call 0x20300a4 first-node init

names.name: intrusive_list_append
names.comment: append node r1 to tail; empty -> call 0x20300a4; else link old tail -> new node via link offset, tail@[r0,#4]=r1, count++

names.name: intrusive_list_init_first_node
names.comment: empty-list first node: node next/prev=0, head@[r0]=tail@[r0,#4]=r1, count@[r0,#8]=1

names.name: intrusive_list_init
names.comment: zero head/tail/count, set link offset halfword [r0,#0xa]=r1

names.name: aligned_size_gated_call_0x2030a50
names.comment: align r0/r1 to 4 (bic #3), require r0<=r1 and size>=0x30 then bl 0x2030a50 else return 0

names.name: intrusive_list_update_all_backref
names.comment: walk list head@[r0,#0x24] (next@+0xc) setting each node+8=[r0,#0x1c], then [r0,#0x28]=[r0,#0x1c]

names.name: bounded_array_slot_get
names.comment: bounds check idx r1 vs count@[r0,#0x1c], stride 0xc from base+0x20, return slot ptr or NULL if slot==-1

names.name: arm_exception_ctx_save
names.comment: SVC mode context save: save apsr->[r1], sp->[r1,#0x40], stm all regs, pc+8->[r1,#0x3c]; returns 0

names.name: arm_exception_ctx_restore
names.comment: SVC mode context restore: msr spsr_fsxc, ldr sp/lr, ldm ^ all regs, subs pc, lr, #4 (return from exception)

names.name: unaligned_halfword_memcpy
names.comment: halfword copy r2 count with unaligned src/dst handling (ldrh/strh, tst #1, eor align check)

names.name: const_400_wrap_call_0x2104c1c
names.comment: mov r1,#0x400; stack args; 3 pc-relative globals; bl 0x2104c1c; then bl 0x21049dc (global param wrapper)

names.name: shift_normalize_left_binsearch
names.comment: binary-search shift-left normalize: r2=0x1c, sub 0x10/0x8/0x4 by cmp lsr steps, lsl r0,r0,r2; r0>r1 -> return 0 (softfloat-style fraction normalize)

names.name: shift_normalize_left_binsearch
names.comment: same binary-search shift-left normalize algorithm as arm9 0x0204e1b0 (shared lib duplicated on ARM7)

names.name: triple_gate_check_to_0x202f3fc
names.comment: 3 attempts: mov r0,#2/3/4 each bl 0x202f3fc, all must return 0 -> ret 0, any non-zero -> ret 1 (submodule availability gate)
